differences.difference: The Docker process is not PID 1 (the spike saw PIDs 12 to 14), so default signal dispositions apply. Without --init, a Docker PID 1 with no SIGTERM handler ignores docker stop and is killed after the timeout (exit 137). Natively it exits on SIGTERM (exit 143), as under docker run --init.
The kernel hostname is set, but /etc/hostname and /etc/hosts are the image's or Incus's, not Docker's generated files.
A HEALTHCHECK in the image config is not run, so inspect shows no Health state.
VOLUME paths in the image config stay in the container's root filesystem. No anonymous volumes are created.
/dev/shm is the one Incus provides, not Docker's 64 MiB tmpfs.
A create without a name gets its instance name (oc- and the first 12 hex characters of its ID), not one of Docker's generated adjective_surname names.
